plan.title: epic(agents-md): Phase 2 always-on shrink — read-only posture, then managed ≤8KB + daily-core default

narratives.Description: Phase-2 epic after closed #2369 (v0.75.0). Drive consumer always-on acceptance via Wave-0 read-only posture (#2176), then managed-section ≤8192 B and daily-core install default (#2494). #2180 is parallel hardening; #2490 is low-priority maintainer-header work and does not gate consumers.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want a Phase-2 epic that sequences posture-first then consumer AGENTS.md shrink plus daily-core defaults, so that acceptance improves without conflating unfinished #2369 mechanism work with the ≤8KB chase.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 0) Keep this xBRIEF in proposed/ until an operator promotes/activates the epic intentionally — do not activate as part of ingest prep. 1) Wave 0: land #2176 (read-only posture) before activating #2493 session-routing compression. 2) Parallel: #2180 ephemeral posture (not a shrink gate); #2490 maintainer header low priority. 3) Shrink path: #2492 catalog eviction and #2494 daily-core default may proceed without #2176; #2493 waits on #2176. 4) Success: managed ≤8192 B + daily-core default shipped; re-seed absoluteMaxBytes in shrink PRs; hard combined ≤8192 is Phase-3 prep only. 5) Tracking: maintain ## Current shape on issue #2491; child xBRIEFs live beside this epic under xbrief/proposed/ until activated. Verify: task umbrella:current-shape 2491; child issues linked as sub-issues.
narratives.Origin: Enriched from GitHub issue #2491 (Phase-2 epic); predecessor #2369 closed
narratives.Overview: Locked: Wave 0=#2176; #2180 parallel; Phase-2 success=managed≤8192 + daily-core default; #2490 low priority; inherit A/OpenPackage/agents-entry SoT/DD-3 meter from #2369.

narrative.Acceptance: Given Phase-2 shrink work, when #2493 starts, then #2176 posture contract is landed or explicitly waived by operator.
Given Phase-2, when tracking progress, then #2180 remains visible as parallel hardening not blocking #2492/#2494.
Given epic success path, when managed bytes are chased, then command catalog is pointer-evicted from agents-entry.
Given #2176, when routing sections shrink, then the thin card encodes read-only→mutation posture.
Given Phase-2 success criteria, when packaging defaults land, then daily-core is the consumer default tier.
Given consumer-first priority, when capacity allows, then maintainer unmanaged header uses consumer-parity mechanisms without gating #2492–#2494.
